newsitem.title: USA: CME pork belly futures end sharply lower.
newsitem.headline: CME pork belly futures end sharply lower.

text.p: CME pork belly futures closed sharply lower with local long liquidation featured in the closing minutes, traders said.

Pork bellies sped to contract highs early in reaction to higher cash prices but quickly tumbled sharply lower when May and July contracts were unable to penetrate technical resistance at 95.00 cents per lb.
During the selling, talk circulated that this week's higher futures increased movement of pork bellies into storage.
At 1316 CDT, pork bellies closed down 2.925 to 1.275 cents per lb with May off the most at 92.200 cents and July was off 2.825 at 91.850 cents.
May set a contract high early at 95.200 cents and July set a fresh high of 94.950.
